candidates.name: Thai Basil Ground Turkey (Pad Krapow)
candidates.why: Iconic Thai holy-basil stir-fry, genuinely ground-turkey, loose-cooked over jasmine rice with a fried/jammy egg. Fills a Thai gap; distinct from the catalog Thai Basil Beef with Coconut Rice (no coconut, uses fish/oyster/soy over plain rice). Source has no macros; est 510 cal / ~30g protein per bowl - LOW confidence on numbers, HIGH on ingredients.

ingredients: 1 tsp avocado oil or high smoke point oil

candidates.name: Turkey Afritada
candidates.why: Filipino tomato-braised turkey with potato/carrot/peas - hearty stew-over-rice with no analog in the catalog. Uses turkey breast (board-tracked) not ground; very high protein (2 lb turkey over 4 servings). Source has no macros; est ~520 cal over rice. Board note: turkey stock maps to Chicken Broth; roma tomatoes to Diced Tomatoes.

ingredients: 2 lbs cooked turkey, cut in medium sized pieces (turkey breast used)

candidates.name: West African Turkey Peanut Stew (Mafe-Style)
candidates.why: Thick peanut-butter stew (maafe family) - West African variety the catalog lacks; every ingredient board-tracked (peanut butter, sweet potato, chickpeas, spinach all in DB). Uses turkey breast (tracked) not ground. Source-published 330 cal is the soup alone; over rice it clears the dinner gate (~530). Protein not published but turkey+chickpeas+PB is high. MED confidence on cal.

ingredients: 1/8 tsp red pepper flakes or more if you like it spicy
1 medium sweet potato peeled and cut into 1/2 inch pieces - about 4 cups
1 796 ml can diced or crushed fire-roasted tomatoes
1 lb turkey breast cut into 1/2 inch pieces, and sprinkled with salt and pepper
1 398 ml can chickpeas drained and rinsed

candidates.name: Turkey Mole Rice Bowls
candidates.why: Puts the board tracked Mole Paste to work - no mole dish exists in the 513-recipe catalog. Turkey simmered in jarred mole over rice, topped with sesame. Board note: source Mexican chocolate tablet maps to tracked Cocoa Powder (+sugar); mole paste already contains chocolate. Protein form is shredded/pieces (turkey breast tracked) - can rebuild with ground turkey. LOW confidence on macros: source 72 cal/11g is the SAUCE only; a full bowl is ~550 cal, 30g+ protein.

candidates.name: Turkey Jollof Rice
candidates.why: Nigerian one-pot party rice - excellent batch/budget fit and a West African staple absent from the catalog; every pantry item board-tracked (scotch bonnet maps to Jalapeno). Source captures the authoritative rice base only (568 cal, 10.8g protein); the meal-prep build browns 1 lb ground turkey into the pot to reach the 25g+ protein gate (~600 cal/serving). MED confidence: turkey add is the sourcer build, not in the cited page.

ingredients: White or black pepper to taste
4 cups long-grain rice, rinsed and drained
